- Data flow: model inference occurs in isolated VPC subnets, optional customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM, no customer data persisted beyond request TTL unless caching is explicitly enabled.
- KV cache: can be disabled per route; default TTL 5m for shared workloads.
- Audit logs: per-token metadata available via our console or exported to customer SIEM (S3/Kinesis connector).
